decision: Use the existing M3_D4_C9_MATH_INPUT_BUNDLE_V1 manifest and unchanged MATH_ROW_INDEX/three history JSONL streams as the sole future adapter target; current signed R10 consumer is not directly compatible.

current_capacity.guard_meaning: 512 MiB per artifact, not a total-memory or full-window capacity guarantee.
current_capacity.IO: artifact() reads each whole file; mechanical index and public rows materialize lists. Current consumer is not a streaming reader.
current_capacity.integer_semantics: Python arbitrary-precision int; duplicate keys/floats/non-finite values rejected. bool not accepted as integer. Preserve 64/62/128-bit values and raw bit strings.

minimal_same_contract_adapter_request: Add a versioned reader for the existing producer manifest and byte-identical JSONL bodies; do not invent a second math data schema or rewrite producer originals.

Verify each descriptor SHA/bytes, canonical row content hash, global source.line/cycle/time/epoch/raw/reset identity; stream one continuous logical file across byte-preserving transport volumes, preserving algorithm state.

Retain every canonical row and sparse FX/advance/input-apply history, including unknown values and cancelled/unpublished advances. Correlate sparse records by global source identity, never by file position or router/req ID.

Feed existing independent ClockedMath only after equivalent strict source, integer, capture-origin, plan, FRAME/reset/finish and provenance checks; actual PCM remains comparison output, never golden input.

Retain unsupported-profile/PENDING rejection and separately admitted REAL mode. Exact full-window time/memory/volume recovery capacity needs a newly authorized implementation and measured software group.

independent_semantics.public_acceptance: Use actual public event_valid/event_ready acceptance; plan arrival windows are constraints, not observed acceptance. Driver ready labels are not DUT backpressure evidence.
independent_semantics.plan_sequence: Independent event_seq matched to actual public acceptance and staged applications; router_apply_seq remains a separate counter and repeated stage seq is not deduplicated.
independent_semantics.note_on: Reuse the accepted E-to-H-to-C semantic successor: C=H+1 and earliest E+2 without interrupting reset; do not reopen the accepted wording decision.
independent_semantics.reset: Only same-run original asynchronous reset evidence determines epoch; external reset.drv plans and transport volume boundaries are not actual reset edges.
independent_semantics.profile: Current bounded Piano/Triangle ordinary notes/NoteOff and stereo delay profile only; no claim of general controls, arbitrary advance masks or untested full-window coverage.

execution.new_implementation_or_test_budget: NOT_GRANTED_BY_THIS_RESPONSE; obtain exact M2 scope and numeric budget, do not reuse consumed R10 software allowance.
